findings.evidence: Measured root overflow; full-page screenshot expanded to438px and wordmark extends beyond viewport.
findings.action: Allow wordmark wrap or bounded responsive scaling that respects text enlargement; verify390 and320 after fix.
findings.resolution: NORTH/wbr/LINE and width-aware reflow; measured root overflow0 at390 and320 with doubled non-SVG text. Both captures viewed.

findings.evidence: North issue remains yellow after selecting East. Current script changes detail but not selected/pressed state. Yellow may be severity but meaning is not explained.
findings.action: If yellow means selection, update aria-pressed/current and selected styling; if urgency, label urgency explicitly and give selected item a separate state.
findings.resolution: East click gives East aria-pressed=true, North=false and yellow East/white North; returning North reverses pressed state.

findings.evidence: 600-unit SVG scales into roughly340px region;18-unit source labels render around10px and SVG text is excluded from doubled-text scenario.
findings.action: Provide a readable HTML route summary or mobile-specific labels that scale with text.
findings.resolution: Tiny schematic labels remain, but a readable HTML route summary duplicates the route at14px default/28px in text stress. Diagram no longer carries unique small-text information.

limits: No native OS or physical-device behavior tested.
No screen-reader, actual virtual keyboard, complete accessible-name algorithm or persistent storage validation.
Full-page screenshots combine a short viewport with scrollable content; they do not mean content fits on one screen.
Flow clicks were scripted DOM clicks/requestSubmit; quantity focus checked by activeElement and bounding rectangle.
No comparative superiority, designer preference, task-success rate or WCAG certification inferred.

followUp.method: Fresh isolated Chromium capture and same doubled non-SVG font-size stress at390×568 and320×568. Viewed both full-page captures. Scripted East/North selection and blocked/valid decisions.
